whatItIs: qSim is an open-source project in the general-purpose sdks category. It is maintained by haykkh and primarily looks like a C++ codebase. Quantum computer simulator library

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches general-purpose sdks workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: I'm building this to learn **C++** and **Quantum Information Theory** simultaneously, so don't be surprised if they're both wrong. Instead, feel free to create a new issue or a new pull request so you can rub in exactly what I did wrong in a concise, well commented manner...
